Specification: This module is a small test specification whose purpose is to exercise user-definable infix, postfix, and prefix operators in TLA+. It defines a single variable x, an initial condition setting x to 0, and a Next action that assigns x' to the result of applying many custom operators to x and the constant 1. The spec does not define a full temporal Spec formula or verify liveness or safety properties; instead, it is structured as a parsing and definability test for operator syntax, while also extending TLC because some related operators are mentioned in comments as already defined there.
